<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Pagină-1" id="vWR3Y8U4rHYtrny4ng1T"> <mxGraphModel dx="2049" dy="1152" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml UC2_Social
 left to right direction
 skinparam packageStyle rectangle
 skinparam actorStyle awesome

 actor Owner

 rectangle \"DogApp – 2. Social\" {
 ' --- Profile ---
 usecase \"Manage my profile\" as UC_Profile
 usecase \"Add / edit / remove dog\" as UC_ManageDog
 usecase \"Delete account\" as UC_DeleteAccount
 usecase \"Anonymize messages,\ncancel my events\" as UC_Anonymize

 ' --- Feed & posts ---
 usecase \"View nearby feed\" as UC_Feed
 usecase \"Create post\" as UC_CreatePost
 usecase \"Tag a dog in post\" as UC_TagDog
 usecase \"Delete own post\" as UC_DeletePost
 usecase \"Like / unlike post\" as UC_Like
 usecase \"Comment on post\" as UC_Comment
 usecase \"View user profile\" as UC_ViewProfile

 ' --- Chat ---
 usecase \"Start conversation\" as UC_StartConv
 usecase \"Send message\" as UC_SendMsg
 usecase \"View conversations\n(unread count)\" as UC_Inbox
 usecase \"Read conversation\" as UC_ReadConv
 usecase \"Update lastReadAt\" as UC_LastRead

 ' --- Safety ---
 usecase \"Block user\" as UC_Block
 usecase \"Report user / post\" as UC_Report
 usecase \"Exclude blocked users\" as UC_ExcludeBlocked
 }

 Owner --> UC_Profile
 Owner --> UC_Feed
 Owner --> UC_CreatePost
 Owner --> UC_Inbox
 Owner --> UC_ViewProfile

 UC_ManageDog ..> UC_Profile : <<extend>>
 UC_DeleteAccount ..> UC_Profile : <<extend>>
 UC_DeleteAccount ..> UC_Anonymize : <<include>>

 UC_Feed ..> UC_ExcludeBlocked : <<include>>
 UC_TagDog ..> UC_CreatePost : <<extend>>
 UC_DeletePost ..> UC_Feed : <<extend>>
 UC_Like ..> UC_Feed : <<extend>>
 UC_Comment ..> UC_Feed : <<extend>>
 UC_Report ..> UC_Feed : <<extend>>

 UC_StartConv ..> UC_ViewProfile : <<extend>>
 UC_Block ..> UC_ViewProfile : <<extend>>
 UC_Report ..> UC_ViewProfile : <<extend>>

 UC_ReadConv ..> UC_Inbox : <<extend>>
 UC_ReadConv ..> UC_LastRead : <<include>>
 UC_SendMsg ..> UC_ReadConv : <<extend>>
 UC_StartConv ..> UC_SendMsg : <<include>>
 UC_Inbox ..> UC_ExcludeBlocked : <<include>>

 note right of UC_Feed
 MVP: posts from users within
 the same radius as search.
 No Follow table yet.
 end note

 note right of UC_Anonymize
 CASCADE: dogs, posts, likes,
 comments, health records.
 SET NULL: Message.senderId
 (\"Deleted user\").
 Organized events → CANCELLED.
 end note

 note bottom of UC_Block
 Blocked user can no longer
 message me, see my posts
 or find me in search.
 end not",
 "config": null
